21bao.note: Local Windows opencode.exe v1.17.8. No wrapper script (vibedev-opencode.bat missing, see P16). Env vars loaded via Windows user env.

5bao.note: Remote Debian worker. Uses wrapper + env file for credential loading. Known credential source: 6-provider set verified. opencode installed but version not verified as part of this preflight.

9bao.note: Remote Debian worker. Same SSH key as 5bao. Known credential gaps (missing volcengine/minimax) may impact broader model verification but D4 uses opencode-go provider which was present in both nodes.

model_call_verified_current_status.note: model_call_verified=unknown for all 3 nodes. G-L4 is the first phase to address model_call_verified. This requires explicit operator authorization for live model calls.

operator_approved_current_status.note: operator_approved=unknown for all 3 nodes. Must not be automatically promoted alongside model_call_verified. Requires separate per-model operator decision.

proposed_execution_order.rationale: Minimum blast radius. 21bao is the control host — fastest turnaround, no SSH dependency. Model call succeeds/fails here first.
proposed_execution_order.fallback_strategy: NO_FALLBACK — single node failure must NOT auto-fallback to another model or node

proposed_execution_order.rationale: Remote Debian worker with proven credential set (6-provider documented). SSH required. Lower risk than 9bao.
proposed_execution_order.fallback_strategy: NO_FALLBACK — single node failure must NOT auto-fallback

proposed_execution_order.rationale: Remote Debian worker. Execute last after 21bao and 5bao are verified. Known credential gaps (volcengine/minimax) but D4 uses opencode-go which is present.
proposed_execution_order.fallback_strategy: NO_FALLBACK — single node failure must NOT auto-fallback

failure_handling.single_node_failure: REPORT_AND_STOP. Do NOT fallback to alternative model. Do NOT automatically retry with different key. Do NOT automatically promote model_call_verified on other nodes.
failure_handling.credential_missing: Report env var name presence/absence (not value). Do NOT provision credential. Operator authorizes credential fix separately.
failure_handling.timeout_or_network: Retry exactly once after 30s cooldown. If still fails, REPORT and STOP.
failure_handling.post_failure_operations: Model_call_verified remains unknown for that node. No automatic NMC write-back. No automatic operator_approved promotion.

per_node_receipt.note: Model_call_verified=true only if exit_code=0 AND expected_marker_detected=true AND fallback_attempted=false. Any deviation → model_call_verified=false for this node.

required_for_each_node: Node-specific work order: which node, which model, which invocation form
Credential policy: check env var presence, do NOT read value, do NOT provision
Failure policy: STOP on any failure, do NOT auto-fallback, do NOT auto-promote
Write-back policy: model_call_verified set only in bounded PR after operator reviews receipts
Boundary guard: do NOT transition to G-L4 readiness without separate operator authorization
global_authorizations_not_granted: G-L4 model_call_verified promotion across all nodes
